# C152 MF07 decoder — Bを基準にした再構成試験 / 2026-11-10
# 末尾の専用セルだけを実行する。既存セルは実行しない。
from google.colab import files
uploaded_reconstruction = files.upload()
# 入力を照合し、別プロセスで依存環境を準備する
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, zipfile, json, subprocess, sys
recon_archive_name = 'irodori-mf07-reconstruction-input-20261110-v2.zip'
assert recon_archive_name in uploaded_reconstruction
recon_blob = uploaded_reconstruction[recon_archive_name]
assert hashlib.sha256(recon_blob).hexdigest() == '1e7375d03dcf1998725e0199c2d6ff788c1d0975c617ae6e284e7e2a40813756'
recon_input = Path('/content/sumi_mf07_reconstruction_input')
recon_input.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
import io
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(recon_blob)) as archive:
    for entry in archive.infolist():
        assert (recon_input / entry.filename).resolve().is_relative_to(recon_input.resolve())
    archive.extractall(recon_input)
for name, expected in json.loads((recon_input / 'SHA256.json').read_text()).items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((recon_input / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
print('RECONSTRUCTION_INPUT_VERIFIED', len(recon_blob))
recon_setup_log = Path('/content/sumi_mf07_reconstruction_setup.log')
with recon_setup_log.open('x') as stream:
    recon_setup = subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','1200s',sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','torch==2.10.0','numpy==2.2.6','scipy==1.15.3'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('SETUP_STARTED', recon_setup.pid)
# 準備の状態を確認する。RETURN_CODEが0になるまで次へ進まない。
print('SETUP_RETURN_CODE', recon_setup.poll())
print(recon_setup_log.read_text()[-2500:])
# テスト成功・GPU接続を確認して学習を開始する
assert recon_setup.poll() == 0
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(recon_input),'-p','test_decoder.py','-v'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'],check=True)
recon_output = Path('/content/sumi_mf07_reconstruction_output')
assert not recon_output.exists()
recon_training_log = Path('/content/sumi_mf07_reconstruction_training.log')
with recon_training_log.open('x') as stream:
    recon_training = subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','960s',sys.executable,'-u',str(recon_input/'train_decoder.py'),'--data',str(recon_input/'data'),'--initial',str(recon_input/'initial.pt'),'--output',str(recon_output),'--device','cuda','--steps','2000','--max-seconds','900'],stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('TRAINING_STARTED', recon_training.pid)
# 学習の状態を確認する。最終比較の音質は別途試聴する。
print('TRAINING_RETURN_CODE', recon_training.poll())
print(recon_training_log.read_text()[-3500:])
if (recon_output/'completed.json').exists():
    print((recon_output/'completed.json').read_text())
# 結果と途中の重みを保存する。Macへの保存・照合後にGPUを停止する。
from google.colab import files
assert recon_training.poll() is not None
recon_result_zip = Path('/content/sumi_mf07_reconstruction_results_20261111.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(recon_result_zip,'x',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for root,label in [(recon_output,'outputs'),(recon_input,'input')]:
        if root.exists():
            for item in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
                if item.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in item.parts:
                    archive.write(item,label+'/'+str(item.relative_to(root)))
    for item in [recon_setup_log,recon_training_log]:
        if item.exists(): archive.write(item,'logs/'+item.name)
print('RESULT_ZIP',recon_result_zip.stat().st_size,hashlib.sha256(recon_result_zip.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
files.download(str(recon_result_zip))
